findings.measured: the "%" half holds; a "\" is normalised to "/" by Next and answered 308 to the normalised target before proxy.ts runs, and that target is then refused 401 by the ordinary gate
findings.says: a malformed/noncanonical escaped target, backslash target, or escaped non-conversation target is answered 400 {"ok":false,"error":"invalid client v1 path"}
findings.where: docs/api/client-v1.md — Reaching the API at all
findings.why: no handler is reached and nothing is served, so the gate still holds; the doc describes an answer no client will observe

findings.measured: the proxy's sidecar-token gate answers first, so the wire carries 401 {"ok":false,"error":"unauthorized"} and requireClientV1Admin's envelope is never produced on a Cave with a token configured
findings.says: a mismatched or absent x-coven-cave-token is 401 unauthorized from requireClientV1Admin
findings.why: the refusal is correct and same-status; only its body differs from the documented one, which a handler-level test cannot see

notCovered: The SDK and Chat halves of #4838. Both live in other repositories; this run is the Cave half only.
The production Coven daemon. /familiars is served from a loopback fixture daemon in hub mode.
A genuinely remote peer. Off-machine ingress is exercised by making the listener classify a loopback request as forwarded.
The write scopes. Nothing enforces them yet — there are no write routes on this surface.
OAuth-backed flows and the desktop consent UI. Approval is driven through the admin HTTP route.
Cross-process pairing state. The pairing store is in-memory and process-local by contract.
